s1.syndrome_frame: a gradually enlarging, red, cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule on the upper arm
salient_findings: red tumor on the right upper arm
key_facts: 16-year-old girl
previously healthy
lesion started as a small cutaneous nodule
enlarged over 6 months
no history of local trauma or insect bite
unremarkable personal, past, and family histories
6 × 6-cm protuberant, thick-walled, and well-defined red tumor
nontender, firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor
normal laboratory tests
normal physical and systemic examinations
multilocular spaces below the epidermis on pathological examination
solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance

raw.syndrome_frame: a gradually enlarging, red, cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule on the upper arm
salient_findings: red tumor on the right upper arm
key_facts: 16-year-old girl
previously healthy
lesion started as a small cutaneous nodule
enlarged over 6 months
no history of local trauma or insect bite
unremarkable personal, past, and family histories
6 × 6-cm protuberant, thick-walled, and well-defined red tumor
nontender, firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor
normal laboratory tests
normal physical and systemic examinations
multilocular spaces below the epidermis on pathological examination
solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance

raw.rationale: The presence of a red tumor with a hard nodule inside, multilocular spaces below the epidermis, and a solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance on pathological examination are characteristic of bullous pilomatricoma.

rejected.label: granular cell tumor
rejected.why: Lack of specific granular cell features in the pathological examination

rejected.label: schwannoma
rejected.why: No mention of nerve involvement or features typical of schwannoma in the pathological examination

rejected.label: cutaneous leishmaniasis
rejected.why: No history of insect bite or exposure to endemic areas, and pathological findings do not match leishmaniasis

rejected.label: sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Normal laboratory tests and lack of systemic symptoms or other organ involvement typical of sarcoidosis
